notes: v0.6w // BASALT // GHOSTLIGHT (ALPHA): broad hardening pass across the daemon. Per-target system-prompt history buckets; credential-approval previews now show the full frozen canonical request and refuse what cannot be displayed; TLS listeners accept per-connection with a bounded handshake so an idle socket can no longer stall the door; UI base is prefix-agnostic (own slug or none, foreign prefixes 404); community installs activate residents in-daemon; uploads are claimed, quota-charged and stamped before any file write; imports dedupe repeated attachments, charge per reference, and publish in one transaction with rollback; backups can no longer export containers their own verifier refuses, and CLI restore now stages a whole tree and swaps it atomically (replace finally means replace); updater swaps journal first, advance anti-rollback state only after a verified swap, and boot reconciles or discards honestly; update snapshots redact secret settings; revocation is enforced mid-turn; guest identity carries an early conversation announcement, a SQL-scoped list with an index, and no guest id in responses; approval decide+grant is one transaction; first boot welds until an active owner exists with a one-time setup token when bound beyond loopback; per-guest memory layers stay private while share history is off; guests can only demolish their own threads; the log catalog is complete and loud about unknown codes; v1 tokens enforce length with per-IP failure buckets; header-read deadlines and a per-IP concurrency cap blunt slow clients; pinned connections follow resolver order through vetted answers; responses carry X-Frame-Options, CSP frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and no-store on /api; local CA gets nameConstraints; passwords get self-service change, owner reset, and a CLI recovery door; and each share can now opt guests out of the sharer's constitution and persona projection independently. Evidence: 40-check regression bed green on these exact bytes, 13-block JS syntax gate, manifest round-trip through the shipped validator with teeth-tested negative controls. Alpha: further hardening is in progress; expect continued fixes before 0.7. Nonce 14.
